source.name: Interfax: Gazprom Neft entered the ownership structure of hockey club SKA
source.quote: генеральным спонсором ХК СКА, как и прежде, является группа "Газпром"
source.note: Gazprom Neft's press service told Interfax (15 May 2026) that 'the change in SKA's ownership is technical; the general sponsor of HC SKA, as before, is the Gazprom group'. Interfax adds Gazprom has sponsored SKA hockey since 2005.

source.name: Stavka TV: Sponsors and owners of KHL clubs (Спонсоры и владельцы клубов КХЛ)
source.quote: Спонсоры: ПАО Газпром (генеральный спонсор), «Газпром нефть», Сеть АЗС Газпромнефть, G-Drive, АвтоРадио, БК «Олимпбет».
source.note: In the article's СКА section (updated 2 May 2026): 'Sponsors: Gazprom PJSC (general sponsor), Gazprom Neft, the Gazpromneft filling-station network, G-Drive, AvtoRadio, bookmaker Olimpbet.' G-Drive is a Gazprom Neft brand.

source.name: Sports.ru: Olimpbet became a partner of hockey club SKA (Olimpbet стал партнером хоккейного СКА)
source.quote: В рамках соглашения логотип букмекера появится на игровой форме хоккеистов: шлемах и рукавах джерси.
source.note: 'Under the agreement the bookmaker's logo will appear on the players' game uniforms: on helmets and on jersey sleeves.' Olimpbet signed a three-year contract with SKA starting in the 2025-26 season, so it covers 2026-27.

summary: 2026-27 home kit. Olimpbet is on the jersey sleeves and helmets under a three-year deal from 2025-26 (Sports.ru). The Gazprom group is SKA's general sponsor (Gazprom Neft's press service to Interfax, May 2026); Gazprom Neft and its G-Drive brand are also listed among SKA's sponsors by Stavka TV (Jan 2026, updated May 2026). None of these sources gives the jersey placement for Gazprom or Gazprom Neft, and SKA's own site 403s from this network, so per-placement details could not be checked there and the list may not be complete. Gazprom Neft has owned 99.99% of the club since May 2026 (Interfax).
